The bank's other faces ride the same harvest: the launch-adjacent compound (274/291/300, the clamp+pin regime -- recorded, not built on) and the PD-authority face (MINE-ONLY: the [dvq] tau/cap census at the fire vs the gap -- any authority change is a new constant and is FORBIDDEN without a derivation; the k-gate/muscle program owns the constants).

THE INSTRUMENT SHIPS FIRST (read-only plumbing, BEFORE any law): gait_controller.hpp gains the per-tick [dvfk] STANCE-SIDE series -- per hind leg, ONE line per servo call gated to the hip drive in the two STANCE branches the swing leg's gap is built in: the stand-first hold branch (br=d; qh/qk/qa are the branch's OWN hind_step_ik outputs for the pinned target stgt, printed, not re-computed) and the stance tables branch (br=t; qstar[0..2] the tables' own pose at phi_[hl]). Fields: phi the leg's own phase clock, qh/qk/qa the STANCE TARGET joint angles, ah/ak/aa the ACTUALS s_.q[hind_coord_[hl][0..2]], stag hind_step_stand_ticks_[hl], oth the OTHER leg's hind_step_mode_, dl hind_step_deadline_tick_[hl] -- the walk's own clocks, printed, never read back. Line format: [dvfk] t=<tick> leg=<0|1> br=<d|t> phi=<rad> qh=<rad> qk=<rad> qa=<rad> ah=<rad> ak=<rad> aa=<rad> stag=<ticks> oth=<0|1> dl=<tick>. stderr-only GAIT_EVENT_TRACE, stdout-inert (the byte equality is the inertness proof). ZERO new control-flow numeric constants; zero existing call-site bytes changed; gait_unit.cpp BYTE-UNTOUCHED. The FIRE-TICK faces need NO new bytes: the fire's own [dvfj] first sample (the gap e0h/e0k), the [hindstep] fire line (phi, class alt/slot, dl, qerr), the census events (waivefire/unloadgate/guardblock/standhold/holdreturn), and the [hindstep] td lines (the stance spans) are already live plumbing this lane inherits free ([dvfa] wave-42, [dvfj] wave-43).

THE MINE (the declared script mine_wave44.py on the instrumented trace's LAST walk run -- the wave-39..43 declared convention; the era convention receipt_wave41.json verbatim as corrected at wave-42/43: the [hindstep] fire/td lines deduped by full line text; the era span [f, ct], ct the fired leg's first td at t >= f or the trace's end; the [dvfa]/[dvfj]/[dvfk] FIRST sample per (t,leg) the tick-start basis): per fire (ALL 18 eras), on the era leg's own series -- FIRE_GAP e0h/e0k = qh-ah / qk-ak at the fire ([dvfj] first sample, wave-43 verbatim); ERA-END close e1h/e1k at ct (the era's last [dvfj] sample); SWING DECAY per drive = (e1-e0)/(ct-f) rad/tick; STANCE BUILD over [prev_td, f) from the [dvfk] first-sample series: g_h(t)=qh-ah, g_k(t)=qk-ak per branch letter, BUILD dg = g(f-) - g(td+), the per-branch (d/t) sub-span decomposition, the stance drift rate per drive; THE CLOCKS AT THE FIRE: class (alt/slot), stance span f - last_td, dl and its unload/fold face where printed, the census events at the fire tick, the other leg's mode, phi; CMD_peak/DEL_peak carried from the [dvfa] series (the wave-42/43 verbatim); the [dvq] tau/cap at the fire (the PD-authority face: PINNED/flows per era, wave-43 verbatim); the launch-adjacent rows (274/291/300) carried in the same table.
